ValidationRule.description: Prevents legacy picklist value 'USA' to be selected. Prompts user to select 'United States'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(Billing_Country__r.Name = 'USA', Billing_Country__r.Name = 'United States of America'), NOT( $Setup.OpportunityAttribution__c.BypassValidation__c ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select the active version (United States) of billing country. USA is no longer supported.
